_comment: The self-hosted basemap. Absence of this file, or an empty url, disables every map surface's tile layer and leaves the drawn SVG in place — a supported state, not a broken one.
_size: 116 MB. Covers Chiang Mai + Chiang Rai provinces whole, z0-15. The planet build's own max zoom is 15, so 15 is everything there is — MapLibre overzooms past it from z15 data rather than fetching more.
_hosting: TOO BIG FOR THE REPO: GitHub rejects files over 100 MB. This must live in R2 (or any host doing HTTP range requests) and the url below must point there before deploy. The relative path is for local verification only.
_url_note: RELATIVE, and resolved against the SITE root by map.js (data-root on <html>), so it is https://motdang.net/tiles/cm-cr.pmtiles in production and the docs/tiles symlink locally. Moved off the public pub-*.r2.dev development URL on 2026-08-20: that host is rate-limited by Cloudflare, is a second origin (an extra DNS+TLS handshake on a phone before a single tile arrives), and answers WITHOUT Cache-Control — while publish/worker.js already serves this exact file same-origin with 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' and full Range support. Verified byte-identical (sha256 of bytes 0-127 matches on both hosts) and 206 with content-range on the site origin before the switch. The absolute r2.dev URL still works if this ever needs rolling back — an absolute URL resolves to itself and ignores data-root.
_glyphs_note: Self-hosted since 2026-08-20 — was https://protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf, which was the last third-party request any page on this site made. Four ranges of Noto Sans (SIL OFL) live in assets/glyphs/NotoSans/ and are copied into docs/glyphs/ by build.py; the stack is named without spaces on purpose (see that folder's README). RELATIVE like the tiles url, and absolutised by map.js against the site root — but only the part BEFORE the first brace, because {fontstack} and {range} are placeholders MapLibre substitutes verbatim and percent-encoding them breaks every label. Set this back to the protomaps URL to roll back; labels vanish rather than degrade if the path is wrong, so check for real bytes at glyphs/NotoSans/3584-3839.pbf after any change.
_enable: Live. Served from the same R2 bucket as the site, via publish/worker.js, which passes Range requests straight through to R2 — pmtiles is nothing but ranged reads. Set url to "" to switch the basemap off everywhere; every map falls back to its drawn SVG.
